title: Picard affine structure projective homology
statement: Let f:X→S be flat, proper and locally of finite presentation, with the ordinary tensor-pullback adjunction structure unit an isomorphism after every base change T→S. Let M, k:W→S and affine U⊂W have M trivial on X×S U. Let P be a bounded complex of projective R=Gamma(W,U)-modules, and assume its termwise affinePerfectSheafification represents on the localized U-site the restriction of R(pullback.snd f k)_*((pullback.fst f k)^*M[0]). For every commutative R-algebra B with structure map φ, the ordinary termwise extension PB=(ModuleCat.extendScalars φ).mapHomologicalComplex(P) has IsZero homology in every integer degree i<0 and H0 isomorphic to ModuleCat.of B B. Use the supplied derived categories on all schemes and localized open sites; termwise finiteness is not required.

proof.text: Extract the upper bound from hb. Projective modules are flat by Module.Flat.of_projective. Apply the proved acyclic_mapBifunctor_of_boundedAbove_flat to obtain the K-flatness hypothesis, then picard_affine_projective_base_change to identify Q(tilde PB) with the base-changed structure direct image.

The proved tilde_preservesHomology and homologyFunctorFactors identify H^i(Q(tilde PB)) with tilde(H^i(PB)). Apply moduleSpecGammaFunctor and the tilde unit isoTop to get the module homology comparison e(i).

Functor.isGE_rightDerivedFunctor_obj_singleFunctor gives vanishing of negative homology of the structure direct image. moduleSpecGammaFunctor preserves zero morphisms, so map_isZero and e(i) give vanishing for PB.

In degree zero use homologyRightDerivedFunctorObjSingleFunctorIso followed by rightDerivedZeroIsoSelf. The proved tensorPullbackObjUnitToUnit_isIso identifies tensor pullback of the unit with O. Apply hO to g and compose the resulting adjunction-unit iso with pushforward of this tensor-unit iso. Global sections of O on Spec B are B, via tildeSelf and toTildeGammaNatIso. Composing these actual isomorphisms with e(0) proves H0(PB) isomorphic to B.

lean.statement:
theorem picard_affine_structure_projective_homology
    [∀ Y : Scheme.{v},
      HasDerivedCategory.{v + 1} (SheafOfModules.{v} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace))]
    [∀ (Y : Scheme.{v}) (U : Y.Opens), HasDerivedCategory.{v + 1}
      (SheafOfModules.{v} ((moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace).over U))]
    {X S : Scheme.{v}} (f : X ⟶ S)
    [Flat f] [IsProper f] [LocallyOfFinitePresentation f]
    (hO : ∀ {T : Scheme.{v}} (g : T ⟶ S),
      IsIso ((Classical.choose
        (Scheme.Modules.exists_tensorPullbackAdjunction (pullback.snd f g))).unit.app
          (SheafOfModules.unit T.ringCatSheaf)))
    (M : X.Modules) (W : Scheme.{v}) (k : W ⟶ S)
    (U : W.Opens) (hU : IsAffineOpen U)
    (htrivial : Nonempty
      ((Modules.tensorPullback (pullback.fst f (U.ι ≫ k))).obj M ≅
        SheafOfModules.unit (pullback f (U.ι ≫ k)).ringCatSheaf))
    (P : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{v} (W.presheaf.obj (.op U))) ℤ)
    (hb : (∃ a b : ℤ, ∀ n : ℤ, n < a ∨ b < n → IsZero (P.X n)))
    (hp : (∀ n : ℤ, Module.Projective (W.presheaf.obj (.op U)) (P.X n)))
    (hrep : Nonempty ((SheafOfModules.overFunctor.{v}
        (moduleRings W.toRingedSpace) U).mapDerivedCategory.obj
        ((schemeDerivedDirectImage (pullback.snd f k)).obj
          ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor
            (SheafOfModules.{v} (moduleRings (pullback f k).toRingedSpace)) 0).obj
            ((Modules.tensorPullback (pullback.fst f k)).obj M))) ≅
        DerivedCategory.Q.obj
          (((affinePerfectSheafification W U hU).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj P))) :
    (∀ (B : Type v) [CommRing B] (φ : W.presheaf.obj (.op U) →+* B),
        let PB := ((ModuleCat.extendScalars φ).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj P
        (∀ i : ℤ, i < 0 → IsZero (PB.homology i)) ∧
          Nonempty (PB.homology 0 ≅ ModuleCat.of B B))
